summary: NVIDIA is actively shipping Vera Rubin GPUs to Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Amazon this month (July 2026), resolving the product-cycle overhang. The 15% pullback from the May ATH creates a compelling DCA entry: analyst consensus $303–309 implies +53% upside with Q2 FY27 earnings (Aug 26) as the next re-rating event.

catalysts.name: Q2 FY2027 Earnings
catalysts.description: Management guided $91B revenue; street at $91.7B. Beat bar = >$93B + guidance ≥$100B for a positive reaction. Vera Rubin revenue recognition begins flowing.
